main_text.l: figurâ referent literam ט hoc modo[?]. Quænam
ergò fuerit stella quæ cultûs objectum patet, at qui
tandem ejus cultores? In duobus exemplaribus
nomine Misam insigniuntur, quod inter tribus aut familias
Arabum illustres non reperio. Sunt quæ literarum
ductu non longè recedunt, تميم Tamim & تيم Tayem, &
جشم Josham, & جشيم Jashim, sed proximè accedit
ميتم Mitam.
Lachmus & Jodamus Jovem ]ita scil. legendum,
non Martem. quod nescio, quomodo calami-festinan-
tis errore, irrepserit. De المشتري autem,
quo nomine Jovis stellam appellant, Etymo, quid
doceat AlMakrizi in iis quæ supra dicta sunt, vidimus.
Monet AlKazwini vocari eandem ab Astrologis
السعد الاكبر i.e. Bona fortuna major seu maxima,
respectu scil Veneris, quæ السعد الاصغر i.e. For-
tuna minor dicitur, quia (inquit) est في فوق الزهرة
السعادة seu felicitate Venerem superat, adeoque
illi الخيرات الكثيرة والسعادات العظيمة i.e. Bona
multa, & felicitates magnas, ascribunt. Eodem
spectat quod asserunt Hebræorum Magistri vocari
apud Arabes Jovis fidus גד Gad quod מזל טוב seu Fortu-
nam bonam interpretantur: certè Arabes (ut
videre est apud Alsaub: & AlFiruzabad, &c.) الجد red-
dunt

marginalia.note: R Mosch. citant Ab. Ezr. ad Gen. 30. & Ps. 65. et Radic. ib. & in radic.

page.notes: Left margin note transcribed as printed; "Ab.Ezr al" and "1/31 65" are doubtful readings, possibly "ad" and "Ps." Word "reddunt" is broken at the line end, and the printed hyphen is uncertain, so it is written as "red-dunt". The Arabic words after "vel" and "quod" in the first lines, the Hebrew letter ט after "literam", and the Arabic pieces in the diagram-like line "هذه الصفة" are copied as seen but may contain small errors. The page ends mid-paragraph, so the text continues on the next page. Some Arabic vowel marks are not clearly visible and are left out.
